scripts.build: npm run build:copy && npm run build:custom --if-present
scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p ./webDriver/static/; SRC=$(node --eval="console.log(require('path').resolve(require('resolve-cwd')('react-film'), '../../dist'))"); DEST=$(realpath ./webDriver/static); rm -rf $DEST; mkdir -p $DEST/js/; cp $SRC/** $DEST/js/
scripts.bump: npm run bump:prod && npm run bump:dev
scripts.bump:dev: PACKAGES_TO_BUMP=$(cat package.json | jq -r '(.pinDependencies // {}) as $P | (.localPeerDependencies // {}) as $L | (.devDependencies // {}) | to_entries | map(select(.key as $K | $L | has($K) | not)) | map(.key + "@" + ($P[.key] // ["latest"])[0]) | join(" ")') && [ ! -z "$PACKAGES_TO_BUMP" ] && npm install $PACKAGES_TO_BUMP || true
scripts.bump:prod: PACKAGES_TO_BUMP=$(cat package.json | jq -r '(.pinDependencies // {}) as $P | (.localPeerDependencies // {}) as $L | (.dependencies // {}) | to_entries | map(select(.key as $K | $L | has($K) | not)) | map(.key + "@" + ($P[.key] // ["latest"])[0]) | join(" ")') && [ ! -z "$PACKAGES_TO_BUMP" ] && npm install $PACKAGES_TO_BUMP || true
scripts.postscaffold: npm run postscaffold:dev --if-present && npm run postscaffold:prod --if-present
scripts.postscaffold:dev: npm install --save-dev $(cat ../common/package.json | jq -r ".name + \"@\" + .version") @happy-dom/global-registrator @tsconfig/strictest expect resolve-cwd typescript
scripts.posttest: if test "$CI" = "true"; then docker compose logs; docker compose down; fi
scripts.pretest: if test "$CI" = "true"; then npm run pretest:docker && npm run pretest:ready; fi
scripts.pretest:docker: npm run build; npm run docker -- --detach --wait
scripts.pretest:ready: until curl -fsS http://localhost:4444/wd/hub/status | jq -e '.value.ready == true' >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done
scripts.switch: cat package.json | jq --arg SWITCH_NAME $SWITCH_NAME -r '(.["switch:" + $SWITCH_NAME] // {}) as $TEMPLATE | .devDependencies += ($TEMPLATE.devDependencies // {}) | .dependencies += ($TEMPLATE.dependencies // {})' | tee ./package.json.tmp && mv ./package.json.tmp ./package.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:types
scripts.init:prod: npm install --save @compulim/test-harness@0.0.0-0 react@18 react-dom@18 react-test-renderer@18 react-film@0.0.0-0
